name: Kosmos-881
about: Kosmos-881 (1976-121A), a crewed vehicle (TKS VA), launched 1976 Dec 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1976 Dec 15), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
